posts.title: Replacing the AUX Port In A 2007 Honda CR-V
posts.description: Every now and then I try to publish something that's more hardware related than my usual articles. This time I'm going to describe how to fix the AUX input for a Third Generation (2007-2011) Honda CR-V. Why so specific? Because it's my wife's car, and I couldn't find out how to change it anywhere else.

posts.title: Why Do Engineers Always Say "It Depends!"?
posts.description: There's a stereotype of "It depends," being the answer that engineers always give to any question. Everyone knows this and, apparently, it's a source of general frustration for non-engineers. So, as it's so upsetting to others, why do we insist on saying it?

posts.title: The Run Book
